title: Quenched Earthy Greek Spinach Spanakopita Pie
description: A hearty, earthy twist on the traditional Greek spinach pie, featuring sweet pineapple and a soothing crust, perfect for a cozy evening meal. Made without eggs for a friendly alternative.

ingredients.name: pineapple
ingredients.notes: canned pineapple in juice, drained and chopped

ingredients.name: chopped spinach
ingredients.notes: frozen spinach, thawed and drained, or 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed

ingredients.name: feta cheese
ingredients.notes: use a gluten-free feta alternative for a gluten-free version

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: use a garlic press for easy mincing

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a flavorful, extra-virgin olive oil for the best taste

ingredients.name: phyllo dough
ingredients.notes: gluten-free phyllo alternative, thawed according to package instructions

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: add to dough to facilitate easy rolling

instructions: Combine the chopped spinach, feta cheese, scallions, garlic, and a pinch of salt in a bowl and mix well.
Add the pineapple to the bowl and stir to combine.
Layer the phyllo dough on a flat surface, brushing each sheet with olive oil and folding in half to create a square shape.
Place a quarter of the phyllo dough mixture into the center of the dough and brush the edges with water.
Fold the phyllo dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal the pie.
Place the pie on a baking sheet and brush the top with olive oil.
Bake the pie for 30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
Let the pie rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve warm, garnished with a sprinkle of paprika and a side of mixed greens salad, if desired.
